title: JustinGuitar Lesson 1 Practice Routine — 20-Minute Daily Plan
summary: This video outlines JustinGuitar’s Lesson 1 practice routine for beginners, prescribing a 20-minute daily practice window with a recommended four sessions per week (daily if possible). It emphasizes focused chord work using a “Chord Perfect Practice” method on the D and A chords, followed by an Anchor Finger drill to position fingers lightly and accurately. The routine includes brief One Minute Changes drills (A to D) with progress logging, then a 10-minute block dedicated to song practice aimed at building repertoire. The session stresses using the practice assistant or related apps to time and log practice, encourages playing songs rather than scales for motivation, and offers scheduling tips to promote regular daily practice.
topics: Frequency: four sessions per week (daily option)
Anchor Finger Work (soft touch, light pressure)
Anchor finger motion within the same fret
Beginner song options (Beginner Song Course app, web play-alongs, original recordings)
Singing while playing (caution / difficulty in initial sessions)
Play songs without apps to gauge progress
Regular practice as the key to progress
